title: Benowitz Kirtland video of a saucer with a PSA plane behind
place_text: Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: there's one of them that looks like a saucer kind of like this. And there's a there's a there's a PSA Pacific Southwest Airlines plane flying behind it.

plain: Around 1980, near Kirtland Air Force Base in New Mexico, a man named Paul Bennewitz filmed footage that, in one clip, shows something shaped like a saucer with a Pacific Southwest Airlines passenger plane flying behind it. Greg Bishop, a guest who has looked at the footage himself, describes it, and he brings it up as part of the story of a man he says was driven to madness by the subject.
